title: chore(release): 0.22.0
body:
## Release 0.22.0

This PR holds the release branch of v0.22.0. The maintainer ordered this cut.

## Start condition

- Cut start: 2026-11-16T10:18Z.
- `main` at the start: `f90e9dc8ecd32a17d5a0379ff7d52f040a3c9d69`. The previous tag is `v0.21.0`.
- Open `P1` issues: none.
- Open `P2` issues: #2004 only. The maintainer released #2004 for this cut on 2026-11-16 ("Cut without #2004"): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/2004#issuecomment-6913297037
- #2004 is under "Known issues" in the release notes. Its fix is in PR #2013 and ships in the next minor.

## What changed

- `RECOMMENDED.md`: `cargo xtask decisions --version 0.22.0` gathered 58 decision files under the `v0.22.0` heading and removed them from `docs/decisions/`.
- `RELEASE_NOTES.md`: a new 0.22.0 section is on top. The older sections are below it and do not change.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: 42 rows for the behaviour PRs that merged since `v0.21.0`.
- `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`: the version is 0.22.0 (`cargo xtask release --version 0.22.0 --no-tag --skip-gate`).

## Breaking

PR #2026 (#1453) is breaking: the project file format goes from 61 to 62. Older builds refuse a file that 0.22.0 saves. The release notes say this first. While the major is 0, this bumps MINOR.

## Upgrade note

After the upgrade, each saved operation shows as out of date one time. Generate it again before a post (PR #2155, issue 2152).

## Checks

- `cargo check -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -j 6`: pass on this branch.
- The release gate (`cut.yml`, stage `gate`) is not started here. The maintainer starts it.
- Pixel snapshots: skipped in this cut. The maintainer decided that they have no value. No PNG changed.
- The Windows arms of the per-OS pinned readings did not run.

title: fix(3d): enable 3D Finish verify gate and fix exposed gouges
body:
## What changed

- Removed ungenerated `R1` and `EM-0600-4FL` from `sample_job()` in `crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies_finish.rs`.
- Asserted `gate.skipped` and `gate.not_judged` are absent, zero gouge problems appear, `gate.ok == true`, and `S1` reports its genuine `shank_hit` collision (`ok == false`, `held_by == ["S1"]`) across all six Z-bands.
- Added `push_support_dir` and `push_shallow_edge_supports` (`cos_min^3` ellipse curvature bound, `MAX_CHORD = 0.006` mm, and `theta = 0` crossings) in `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/scan.rs`.
- Extracted `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/rings_overhang.rs` (`ColumnLaw`, `overhang_column_clear`, `bisect_column_edge`, `trim_blocked_columns`) and wired `emit_rings_with_trim` in `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/rings.rs` to split and trim 3-axis ring runs under overhangs and tight walls (`wall_lim = col_strict` when `tolerance <= 0.05`, `r - tolerance` otherwise).
- Capped `eps_chord` at `0.005` mm in `raster_pass_spaced` and passed `trim_columns = false` from `swarf` and `swarf_multi` in `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/raster.rs`.
- Added three regression pins in `crates/motion/tests/finish3d_overhang_and_chord.rs`.
- Added the decision record in `docs/decisions/1840-finish-verify-gate.md`.

## Cause

- Keeping ungenerated `R1` caused `verify` to skip simulation and return an empty problem list (`worst 12.69 mm` gouge hidden across four bands).
- Coarse XY direction spacing on shallow-Z edges skipped tangency points along wall slices, creating chord gouges (`0.1479 mm` in the fixture pin).
- Ring levels only checked `column_clear` at a closed cycle's entry vertex, letting open-air entries walk under overhanging canopies (`dist 2.6701 < 2.9900`) and steep-wall V-notches (`2.9878 < 2.995` on Band 5, `0.34 mm` vertical column gouge).
- `eps_chord = p.tolerance * 0.25` (`0.0125 mm` at `0.05` tolerance) with midpoint-only subdivision allowed off-center convex ridges to sag `0.011113 mm > DEV_TOL` (`0.01 mm`).

## Tests

Pins:
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test shared_face_bodies_finish -- --include-ignored`: 8 passed, 0 failed (Bands 1-6 generate, verify runs with zero gouges, and `shank_hit` holds post).
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d_overhang_and_chord`: 3 passed, 0 failed (`shallow_wall_edge_slice_keeps_tie_endpoints_and_ellipse_chord_within_gouge_tol`, `waterline_and_steep_rings_trim_segments_under_overhang_instead_of_cutting_through`, `parallel_raster_over_convex_cylinder_keeps_sagitta_within_stock_sim_dev_tol`).

Mutations:
- `scan.rs` (`push_shallow_edge_supports` reverted to `upstream/main`): `shallow_wall_edge_slice_...` fails (`rings: 2 ring entries refused - their plunge column from the approach plane crosses the solid...`), then passes 3/3 when restored.
- `rings.rs` / `rings_overhang.rs` (disabled `trim_columns` guard): `waterline_and_steep_rings_...` fails (`Waterline move 17 ... cut into overhang: dist=2.6701 < 2.9900`), then passes 3/3 when restored.
- `raster.rs` (reverted `eps_chord` `.min(0.005)` cap): `parallel_raster_over_convex_cylinder_...` fails (`cells=4, max_gouge=0.011113 mm`), then passes 3/3 when restored.

Regression and lint runs after final code changes:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (run with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 RUSTC_WRAPPER=` because host `sccache` timed out): 2 step(s), 0 failed (14.5 min; `camcraft-motion` lib + 12 suites and `camcraft-app` 7 suites).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d -- --include-ignored`: 88 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --test swarf_pose_continuity`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test golden_cl`: 33 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test setup_align_3d`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test shared_face_bodies`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test wall_column_gouge`: 3 passed, 0 failed.

## Goldens moved

None (`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty).

## Not exercised

- `cargo xtask gate release` (full UI pixel snapshots and crates outside `camcraft-motion` / `camcraft-app`).

## Overlaps

- `#1713` (`feat(finish3d): gap_link - a straight link across gap openings`) touches `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/raster.rs` (serpentine piece-reversal lines inside `raster_pass_spaced`, different hunk/lines from our `eps_chord` cap and `rings_and_tail_with_trim` / `swarf` / `swarf_multi`); whichever merges second refreshes.

Effort: max
Changelog: Fix 3D Finish shallow-edge, overhang-trim, and convex-chord gouges and enable full verify gate coverage on the imported sample
Fixes #1840

title: feat(machine): define AC trunnion kinematics fields and non-RTCP flag
body:
Stacked on #2126 (merge #2126 first)

## What changed
- Added `AxisLimits.parent`, `AxisLimits.chain_order`, `pivot`, `offset`, `zero_offset`, `rollover`, and `sign_convention` in `crates/post/src/machine/def.rs` and `crates/post/src/machine/trunnion.rs`, keeping `Machine.axes` sorted by controller coordinate while `Machine::rotary_axes()` returns rotaries in `kinematics.default.parts` parent-child order.
- Updated `collect_axes` and `parse_mch_with` in `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs` to parse optional unit-scaled `pivot`/`offset` lengths, degree `zero_offset`, boolean `rollover`, `controller.rtcp`, and `sign_convention` (`tool_rh` | `table_rh`) under the unstated-limit rule.
- Wired `trunnion_refusals` into `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs` so invalid vectors, mismatched types, disagreeing `sign_convention`, or rotary keys on linear parts fail by name in both `parse_mch` and `validate_text`.
- Extracted rotary/RTCP mirroring into `crates/post/src/post/machine_rotary.rs` so `mirror()` and `script_props()` honor `controller.rtcp = false`, emit `signConvention` (default `tool_rh`), and pass the ordered rotary chain to post scripts.
- Guarded `tilt(p)` in `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` to refuse tilted moves on multi-rotary machines when controller RTCP is false even if rotary clamp codes exist, matching `fanuc.cps`.
- Bumped `PROJECT_VERSION` from 63 to 64 in `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` (stacked on `#2126`) and documented trunnion schema semantics in `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs` and `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`.
- Recorded architectural choices in `docs/decisions/1962-trunnion-schema.md`.

## Cause
The `.mch` schema, validator, and post mirror had no representation for trunnion pivot/offset geometry, zero offset, rollover, parent-child chain order independent of `ctrl_coord` sorting, explicit `tool_rh`/`table_rh` sign convention, or an explicit `controller.rtcp: false` override. Non-vertical rotary axes always inferred controller RTCP geometrically, risking `G43.4` emission on non-RTCP trunnion controls.

## Tests
- Pins (`crates/post/tests/trunnion_schema.rs`, 0/4 passed before fix, 4/4 passed after final edit): `explicit_non_rtcp_trunnion_does_not_promise_controller_compensation`, `rotary_chain_order_preserved_when_controller_coordinates_differ`, `trunnion_fields_parse_and_mirror_with_unit_scaling`, `invalid_trunnion_fields_refuse_by_name`.
- Pins (`crates/app/tests/trunnion_schema.rs`, 0/2 passed before fix, 2/2 passed after final edit): `validator_accepts_ac_trunnion_and_refuses_bad_fields_by_name`, `project_roundtrips_non_rtcp_trunnion_and_protects_version`.
- Targeted app suites (`cargo test -p camcraft-app --test index_swing --test index_swing_horizontal --test trunnion_schema`): 13 + 13 + 2 passed.
- Mutation 1: removed `chain_order` sorting in `crates/post/src/machine/trunnion.rs` (`rotary_axes`): `rotary_chain_order_preserved_when_controller_coordinates_differ` and `trunnion_fields_parse_and_mirror_with_unit_scaling` failed; restored and all 4 passed.
- Mutation 2: reverted `crates/post/src/post/machine.rs`: 3/4 tests in `post::trunnion_schema` failed; restored and passed.
- Mutation 3: reverted `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`: `explicit_non_rtcp_trunnion_does_not_promise_controller_compensation` failed; restored and passed.
- Mutation 4: reverted `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs`: `validator_accepts_ac_trunnion_and_refuses_bad_fields_by_name` failed; restored and passed.
- Mutation 5: reverted `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` to `base-2126`: `project_roundtrips_non_rtcp_trunnion_and_protects_version` failed; restored and passed.
- Clippy and gate: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed (0 warnings); `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (`post`, `motion`, `app`, `ui`; 0 failed).

## Goldens moved
None (`git diff --stat base-2126 -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty).

## Not exercised
- Full non-quick `cargo xtask gate` outside `gate quick --base upstream/main`.
- Downstream CAM-side IK solve and G43.4-less 5-axis posting (`#1965`, `#1968`).
- Interactive UI layout checks.

## Overlaps
- Stacked on `#2126` (`base-2126` sets `PROJECT_VERSION = 63` in `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`; this PR sets `64`).
- Touches the same files in different functions or `PROJECT_VERSION` bumps (whichever merges second refreshes) with open PRs `#2151`, `#2149`, `#2140`, `#2136`, `#2134`, `#2125`, `#2123`, `#2115`, `#2101`, `#2092`, `#2077`, `#2048`, `#2024`, `#1821`, `#1738`, `#1681`, and `#468`.

Changelog: Add optional AC trunnion kinematics fields, rotary chain order, explicit sign convention, and `controller.rtcp` flag to the `.mch` schema and post mirror.

Fixes #1962

title: fix(multiaxis): refuse out-of-range 3+2 tilt by name and keep A0 B180 plane X on machine X
body:
Stacked on #2135 (merge #2135 first).

## What changed

- Added `Tilt::refusal` in `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs` and wired it into `OpParams::named_refusal` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs`). Out-of-range tilt angles now refuse by name with the field (`Tool axis A` or `Tool axis B`), the canonical limits (`-90..90` and `-180..180`), and the `A 0` / `B 180` pose for the face opposite the top.
- Updated `apply_hint` in `crates/ui/src/feedback.rs` to show `draft.named_refusal()` before the generic unusable-value text.
- Updated `TiltedFrame::new` in `crates/cl/src/cl/frame.rs` to zero out axis components smaller than `1e-12` when selecting the tie-breaking seed axis. The `A 0` / `B 180` frame now keeps plane X along machine `+X` (the A rotary axis).
- Updated `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-4axis-part.md`, `crates/app/tests/first_4axis_part.rs`, and `examples/first-4axis-part.camproj` so `Flat A180` uses the same `-0.75, 0` to `-0.25, 0` ends as the other three flats.
- Saved `Tilt.basis_version` with each tilted operation. A missing version uses basis 0 and preserves the original coordinates and digest. New UI and MCP drafts use basis 1 with a distinct cache stamp. The loader refuses an unknown basis version.
- Recorded the design choices in `docs/decisions/2133-tilt-a180-refusal-basis.md`.

## Apply hint screenshots

These images render the shipping shell with egui_kittest. Both images show the same Face draft at A 180 and B 0.
The viewport uses the harness placeholder. The operation page and the Apply hint use the shipping widgets.
The before image uses `feedback.rs` from parent `06dfbcaafab3e6bc98fd2cbed85c9ee884bbfd2c`.
The after image uses `feedback.rs` from reviewed head `e955c9dfed47e7c2d1ce0a73ffd335fa72c04a99`.
The capture code and logs remain outside the PR branch. The images exist only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: generic Apply hint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/6a3b0cc6a54d84170edbc852a85f4bf5ce00f25e/2157/before-apply-hint.png) | ![After: angle limits and A0 B180 remedy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/6a3b0cc6a54d84170edbc852a85f4bf5ce00f25e/2157/after-apply-hint.png) |

The test `apply_hint_names_tilt_limits_and_a0_b180_remedy` fails with the parent source (exit 101).
It passes after the reviewed source is restored (exit 0).

## Cause

1. `Tilt::is_sane` returned `bool` with no entry in `OpParams::named_refusal`. `CreateOperation`, `EditOperationParams`, MCP `add_operation`/`edit_operation`, and the UI Apply hint fell back to generic "not usable" text without stating the limits or the `A 0` / `B 180` pose.
2. `TiltedFrame::from_angles(origin, 0.0, 180.0)` produces `axis[0] = sin(180 deg) ~ 1.22e-16` while `axis[1] = 0.0`. `TiltedFrame::new` compared magnitudes without a float-dust threshold, picked the Y axis as seed instead of X, and swapped plane X and Y on the `A 0` / `B 180` face.

## Tests

- **Pinning tests (red before fix, green after fix):**
  - `cl::tests::a0_b180_frame_keeps_plane_x_on_machine_x` (`crates/cl/src/cl/tests.rs`): failed before fix (`u=[0.0, 1.0, 0.0]`), passes after fix.
  - `tilt_a180::out_of_range_tilt_refuses_by_name_with_a0_b180_remedy` (`crates/app/tests/tilt_a180.rs`): failed before fix (`operation parameters are not usable for a Slot operation`), passes after fix for `CreateOperation`, `EditOperationParams`, MCP `add_operation`, and MCP `edit_operation`.
  - `tilt_a180::a0_b180_slot_cuts_along_machine_x_like_the_other_faces` (`crates/app/tests/tilt_a180.rs`): failed before fix (cut ran along Y at X ~ 0), passes after fix (cuts along X and posts `G0 A180`).
  - `feedback::apply_hint_names_tilt_limits_and_a0_b180_remedy` (`crates/ui/tests/feedback.rs`): failed before fix (`check a deg, b deg, origin - the value is not usable`), passes after fix.
  - `first_4axis_part` (3 tests, ok) and `site/tests/test_first_4axis_part.py` (12 tests, ok).
- **Compatibility pins (`tilt_basis_compat`):**
  - `old_project_keeps_basis_status_regeneration_and_posted_cut` checks an old project at load, status, regeneration, and posting.
  - `corrected_basis_rejects_a_legacy_cache_stamp` checks that basis 1 does not accept a basis 0 cache.
  - `live_json_tilts_use_current_basis_and_preserve_an_explicit_legacy_basis` checks the live JSON version defaults and an explicit basis 0.
  - `unknown_saved_basis_is_visibly_refused_before_loading` checks the visible refusal for an unknown saved basis.
- **Mutation checks:**
  - Reverted `crates/cl/src/cl/frame.rs` to `upstream/main`: `a0_b180_frame_keeps_plane_x_on_machine_x` failed; restored: passed.
  - Reverted `crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs` to `upstream/main`: `out_of_range_tilt_refuses_by_name_with_a0_b180_remedy` failed; restored: passed.
  - Reverted `crates/ui/src/feedback.rs` to `upstream/main`: `apply_hint_names_tilt_limits_and_a0_b180_remedy` failed; restored: passed.
- **Gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, batch fallback):**
  - Steps `[01]`–`[07]` (`geometry`, `kernel`, `cl`, `tools`, `post`, `sim`, `motion`) passed on this tree; `[08]` was interrupted by a server restart, then `--only clippy` (`clippy -D warnings`, 441s), `--only ui` (`ui suites`, 52s), and `--only app` (`app suites`, 1492s) each ran and passed with 0 failures. `xtask` `gate_maps_tests` passed (8 tests, ok).

## Goldens moved

- None. Zero `.nc` or `.cl` files changed against `base-2135` (`examples/first-4axis-part.nc` stayed byte-identical). `examples/first-4axis-part.camproj` updates `Flat A180`'s `a` and `b`, states `basis_version: 1` for tilted operations, and updates their cache stamps. All cached move coordinates match. The example NC file is unchanged.

## Not exercised

- `zola build` and the three `site/tests` tests that invoke `zola` (`zola` is not installed on this host).
- Interactive GUI click-through or physical machine cut.
- Release-lane heavy binaries (`motion:finish3d`, `motion:pivot5d`, `motion:flow`, `app:center_cut_multiaxis`) and UI pixel snapshots.

## Overlaps

- **Stacked on #2135 (`issue/1904-first-4axis-part`):** edits `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-4axis-part.md`, `crates/app/tests/first_4axis_part.rs` (`build`, `each_flat_posts_the_same_cut_after_its_index`), and `examples/first-4axis-part.camproj`. Merge #2135 first.
- **Same files, different functions/lines (whichever merges second refreshes):**
  - `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`: PRs #2126, #2093, #2037, #1817, #1713 touch `OpParams` variants; this PR touches the `Tilt` structure and its implementation.
  - `crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs`: PRs #2126, #2093, #2037, #1817 touch other operations or checks; this PR adds a tilt guard at the start of `OpParams::named_refusal`.

Changelog: refuse out-of-range 3+2 tilt angles by name with the A0 B180 hint and keep A0 B180 plane X along machine X
Effort: high (no escalation)
Fixes #2133

title: fix(post): a cache judged under the old rapid law reads stale
body:
Stacked on #2138. The diff against `main` also shows the commit of #2138 (e7050be17) until #2138 merges. After that merge, only the commit 3fe7da701 is in the diff.

## What changed

- The op stamp salt moves from `camcraft-op-stamp-v2` to `camcraft-op-stamp-v3` (`crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs`).
- #2138 changed the rapid law. The post gate reads only the verdicts that a cache carries, and it does not run the rapid law again. A project saved before #2138 had a cache with a matching stamp. That cache posted a traverse through uncut stock with no warning.
- Now each cache from before this change reads Stale. The post refuses it with the message `<op>: inputs moved since generation - regenerate before posting`. A regenerate judges the path under the new law.
- The salt comment now says: bump the salt when a verify law that a cache records changes.
- `examples/first-router-part.camproj`: the three stamps are the v3 stamps. I regenerated each operation under the new law: the same move count and no warnings. Thus the new stamps are true, and `first_router_part` still posts the committed demo.
- `crates/app/tests/wire_stamp.rs`: `ONE_PROFILE_STAMP` is pinned again for the new salt. The salt is the only change to that digest.
- Decision: `docs/decisions/2152-stale-rapid-verdict.md`. The salt is the smaller mechanism. A project-version migration (v62 -> v63) was dropped: it gives the same result for the user, but older builds then cannot open new files. A re-run of the rapid law at post time was dropped: it is too large for a fix that holds the cut.

The project-file version does not change. Older builds open the files of this build. This is not a breaking change.

## Readings

- Before the salt change, the pin `a_cache_judged_under_the_old_rapid_law_reads_stale_and_holds_the_post` failed: the old-law cache read `Ok` (thus it posted with no warning). After the salt change, the pin passes.

## Pinning tests

- `crates/app/tests/stale_rapid_law.rs`:
  - `a_cache_judged_under_the_old_rapid_law_reads_stale_and_holds_the_post`
  - `regenerating_the_old_cache_judges_it_under_the_new_law`
- Fixture: `crates/app/tests/stale_rapid_law/rapid_law_v2_cache.camproj`. It is the #2121 repro (a Contour with clearance and retract at Z 8, stock top Z 10), saved at e7050be17 with salt v2. I removed the two `rapid_in_stock` verdicts and the "Clearance in stock" note from the cache. The result is the cache that the old law wrote.

## How tested

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base pr-2138`: 31 app suites and the app lib. The first run failed only in `wire_stamp` (the pinned stamp value). After the re-pin, `wire_stamp` and `stale_rapid_law` pass.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_router_part --test clearance_in_stock`: 4 + 8 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Not exercised

- The UI suites. No UI test posts a recorded project. `docs_example_steps_through_operations` checks only that each operation has a toolpath. The #371 fixture test accepts a Stale operation.
- `examples/first-part.camproj`, the microARC kit project and the #371 UI fixture keep their old stamps. They read Stale, and they regenerate one time, as a user's project does.

Effort: high (no escalation).

Changelog: Fixed: a toolpath generated before the clearance-plane rapid check (#2121) now reads stale, and the post refuses it until you regenerate it. Each saved operation regenerates one time after the upgrade.

Fixes #2152

title: fix(2d): omit cleared-floor inner ring legs in rest_pocket
body:
Stacked on #1817 (merge #1817 first)

## What changed
- Added `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest_rings.rs` (`rest_passes`, `clip_loop`, `chain_pieces`) to clip `plan.center` waterline offsets against `cut_zone = plan.rest.offset(r + REST_REACH * 0.5)` (`r + 0.025` mm) and chain surviving pieces interior-out within `cut_center = cut_zone.intersect(&plan.center)`.
- Added `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest_anchor.rs` (`anchor_first_pass`) to re-anchor a pinched-tip open first pass into nearby dive room of its connected component (walking to the tip and doubling back) and rotate a closed first pass toward dive room when its seam lacks clearance.
- Extracted pocket pass emission from `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs` (`pocket_over`) into `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_emit.rs` (`emit_pocket_passes`, `PocketWalks`) so `rest_pocket` keeps identical arc fitting, corner blending, crossing guards, and level links while bounding `links_center` to `&cut_center`.
- Updated `crates/app/tests/rest_pocket.rs`, `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_rest_corners.cl`, and `crates/motion/tests/rest2d.rs` with strict cleared-floor feed pins, and documented choices in `docs/decisions/1816-rest-corner-air.md`.

## Cause
`rest_pocket` previously handed `plan.center` (`rest.offset(r + 0.05).intersect(own_center)`) directly to `pocket_over`'s waterline generator. Each closed offset loop of a crescent rest region fed along the crescent's inner boundary `r + 0.05` mm away from rest stock over already-cleared floor (and closed hole loops under large `previous_stock_to_leave` walked pure air), while opening a ring left pinched corner tips where `descent::plan` fed across cleared floor from the interior to the tip.

## Tests
- **Pins (all failed on `base-1817` before fix, pass after fix):**
  - `crates/app/tests/rest_pocket.rs::read_against_the_simulated_roughing_pass` (tightened `r.2 < 0.5`; previously ~6.72 mm cleared-floor feed per ring across 8 corner runs) — `app rest_pocket` 6/6 ok.
  - `crates/motion/tests/rest2d.rs::rest_rings_do_not_feed_over_cleared_floor` (failed at `55.38 mm` cleared-floor feed; covers `Waterline`, `OffsetRings`, `Auto` x `climb` x `Plunge`/`Helix`/`Ramp`) — ok.
  - `crates/motion/tests/rest2d.rs::deep_corner_and_filleted_turns_clear_residue_without_cleared_floor_laps` (failed at `79.95 mm`; covers `blend_turns`, `Links::PLANAR`/`Links::ROUGH3D`, deep crescents) — ok.
  - `crates/motion/tests/rest2d.rs::previous_stock_to_leave_drops_cleared_floor_hole_lap` (failed at `348.68 mm`; covers `leave=0.3` and `leave=5.8` inner hole-lap dropping/keeping) — ok.
- **Mutations:**
  - Restored `base-1817:crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest2d.rs`: all three `rest2d` pins and `read_against_the_simulated_roughing_pass` FAILED -> restored -> PASSED (`rest2d` 13/13, `rest_pocket` 6/6).
  - Disabled `anchor_first_pass` in `rest2d.rs`: `rest_rings_do_not_feed_over_cleared_floor` FAILED (`0.79 mm` cleared-floor feed) -> restored -> PASSED.
  - Changed `cut_zone` margin in `rest_rings.rs` from `r + REST_REACH * 0.5` to `r + REST_REACH`: `rest_rings_do_not_feed_over_cleared_floor` FAILED -> restored -> PASSED.
- **Gate & Clippy (after final code edit):**
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: 0 warnings, exit 0.
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` across all 3 planned steps (`--only ui`: ok 302s; `--only motion`: ok 1460s; `--only app`: ok 2967s; 0 failed). Steps ran individually so `app suites` (49.5 min alone) stayed under the session runner window.

## Goldens moved
- `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_rest_corners.cl` (added by #1817; vs `base-1817`: `moves=126` -> `moves=84`, 42 moves removed across 3 Z levels `20000`/`18000`/`16000`). Each of the 4 corners drops its cleared-floor inner return arcs (`Arc`/`Feed`), and Corner 1 re-anchors from `(27625, 17307)` to `(27700, 16451)` to cut the tip wall before sweeping the corner arc.

## Not exercised
- `cargo xtask gate release` (heavy `--ignored` suites and UI pixel snapshots).
- Rest pocket interactions with horizontal `arc_xy` or predrilled-hole reseating, and neck/island rest geometries beyond rounded rectangular pockets.

## Overlaps
- **Stacked on #1817** (merge #1817 first; touches `rest2d.rs`, `machining2d/mod.rs`, `tests/rest2d.rs`, `crates/app/tests/rest_pocket.rs`, `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_rest_corners.cl`).

  - `#2149` changes visibility of `PocketParams::validate` / `tiling_step` in `pocket.rs` and edits `machining2d/mod.rs`.

title: feat(post): add Post dialog and per-post declared options (#258)
body:
## What changed
- Added per-post `declaredOptions` schema parsing, type/range validation, reserved host-key guards (`RESERVED_KEYS`), default resolution, and `programTools` stream extraction in `crates/post/src/post/options.rs`, `options_parse.rs`, and `engine.rs`.
- Added `declaredOptions` schemas and option-driven output (such as sequence numbers, word spacing, optional stops, radius arcs, header info/tool lists, and controller toggles) across all eight shipped milling posts (`carvera.cps`, `doosan-dnm.cps`, `fanuc.cps`, `grblhal.cps`, `haas.cps`, `mazak.cps`, `tinyg.cps`, `tormach.cps`) while preserving default output byte-for-byte; documented the schema in `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`.
- Added document and per-setup `PostScriptOptions` persistence (`schema.rs`, `project/*`, `setup_post_options.rs`) using the setup own-vs-follow law, and flagged multi-setup script option disagreements in `program_problems`.
- Added undoable commands `SetPostScriptOptions`, `SetSetupPostScriptOptions`, and composite `SetPostSettings` (`crates/app/src/commands/post_script_options.rs`).
- Extended MCP `get_post_options` / `set_post_options` (`crates/app/src/mcp/post_options_tools.rs`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`), scripting `cam.post({ options })` (`crates/app/src/script/api.rs`, `script/mod.rs`, `assets/scripts/cam.d.ts`), `camcraft-cli process --post-option <k=v>` (`crates/app/src/cli.rs`), and standalone `post --opt <k=v>` / `--list-options` (`crates/post/src/bin/post.rs`).
- Added the floating desktop `Post` dialog with `Settings` and `Operations` tabs, output folder/filename memory, program number/comment fields, built-in post switches, and grouped declared script options (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs`, `post_dialog_tabs.rs`, `post_script_options.rs`, `post_options.rs`, `setup_post_page.rs`, `shell.rs`, `state.rs`, `state_per_op.rs`, `state_setup_post_options.rs`).

title: feat(import): open Solidcraft .sc designs as a model
body:
Needs maintainer: adds the native camcraft-geometry -> camcraft-kernel dependency (decision file included).

Branch base: upstream/main af83da0f.

## What changed
- CamCraft opens a Solidcraft `.sc` design as a model. The app reads the cached final body of the design.
- Model > Open offers `.sc`. A viewport drop takes `.sc`. MCP `import_model` takes `.sc`.
- These three use the one model import. The `Format::Solidcraft` arm in app dispatches to the re-exported `camcraft_geometry::solidcraft` parser.
- The module calls `camcraft_kernel::solidcraft::import_solidcraft`. Then it meshes the body with `camcraft_kernel::machining_mesh::machining_mesh` at the STEP chord cap (0.005 mm).
- A damaged or unsupported `.sc` is refused by name. The message is "Solidcraft design refused: <kernel reason>". The model is not added and the history does not change.
- A watchdog requests cooperative cancellation after 300 seconds. The kernel planner has no cancellation hook. Completion within 300 seconds is not guaranteed.
- A STEP facet budget for a `.sc` is refused by name, as for STL and OBJ.
- The kernel edge is native only. The browser build does not offer `.sc`, and it refuses `.sc` by name.
- `camcraft-kernel` re-exports `CancelToken`, so geometry does not need its own solidcore dependency.
- Open and drop now use one extension list (`state::MODEL_EXTENSIONS`). The drop refusal message comes from that list.
- Decision file: `docs/decisions/1456-sc-open.md`. It lists the imported kernel items, why the caller cannot pass the value in, and what rebuilds.

## Review screenshots

Before uses the production UI files from `af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824`.
After uses the production UI files from `8ad6817541bd9acf2c917ed0bc57544aab2bec5f`.
The parser move does not change these UI files.

The native Linux captures call the production `mesh_dialog()` through a temporary test entry point.
Only the starting directory is set for the capture. The directory contains the same STL, Solidcraft, and text files.
The GTK portal applies the real Mesh filter. Before hides the Solidcraft file. After shows it.

| Picker before | Picker after |
| --- | --- |
| ![Picker before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/994d7844862ea66d4f2a4fea134a370a75566fb3/2150/picker-before.png) | ![Picker after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/994d7844862ea66d4f2a4fea134a370a75566fb3/2150/picker-after.png) |

The drop captures render the production shell through the existing egui test harness.
The production classifier refuses `notes.txt`. The shell displays that refusal on its status line.
Before lists STL, OBJ, STEP, and STP. After also lists SC.

| Drop refusal before | Drop refusal after |
| --- | --- |
| ![Drop refusal before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/994d7844862ea66d4f2a4fea134a370a75566fb3/2150/drop-before.png) | ![Drop refusal after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/994d7844862ea66d4f2a4fea134a370a75566fb3/2150/drop-after.png) |

The images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `994d7844862ea66d4f2a4fea134a370a75566fb3`.
No capture code or images are added to this PR branch.

## Cause
The kernel reader from #1464 and #1474 is in main. No code in `crates/app/src` called it. Thus Model > Open did not offer `.sc`.

## Current verification

Head: `13d33b478a7539271fa2ce0a124009f1759c9bd9`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green. Manifest changes select the batch fallback. All 10 steps pass.
- All-target clippy with `-D warnings` on geometry, app, and UI: green through the gate.
- Separate kernel clippy with `-D warnings`: green.
- New geometry pin: `domain_parser_preserves_the_kernel_refusal_reason`.
- Placement mutation: removing the public geometry module makes the pin fail to compile. Restoring the module makes it pass.
- Diagnostic mutation: removing the kernel reason makes the new pin fail. Restoring the reason makes it pass.
- Drop mutation: removing `sc` from `MODEL_EXTENSIONS` makes `a_solidcraft_design_drop_queues_the_import` fail. Restoring `sc` makes it pass.
- Screenshot evidence check: removing one image link fails the four-image check. Restoring the link makes it pass.
- The four screenshot URLs return HTTP 200. Their bytes match the local captures.

## Existing import pins

- `crates/app/tests/import_solidcraft.rs`:
  - `damaged_and_unsupported_sc_files_are_refused_by_name` (debug)
  - `mcp_import_model_refuses_a_damaged_solidcraft_design_by_name` (debug)
  - `a_facet_budget_is_refused_for_a_solidcraft_design` (debug)
  - `the_sample_design_imports_at_its_design_box` (heavy lane, `--release -- --ignored`)
  - `mcp_import_model_opens_a_solidcraft_design` (heavy lane, `--release -- --ignored`)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs`: `a_solidcraft_design_drop_queues_the_import`.
- Before the initial feature fix, the sample, damaged-file, and MCP pins failed with "unsupported file type: solidcraft_for_beginners.sc".
- Historical sample result: the two heavy tests passed in release in 52 seconds together. They mesh the sample at 0.005 mm.
- The release heavy tests were not run again for this review fix.

## Goldens moved
None.

## Not exercised
- The wasm (browser) build. The wasm32 target is not installed on this machine. The kernel edge is behind `cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))`, and the wasm branch of `camcraft_geometry::solidcraft::parse` is a plain refusal.
- Windows and macOS.
- Multi-body, assembly, non-mm and other cache versions. The kernel reader refuses these by name. No sample file was available.
- Clicking Model > Open in the full desktop app. The screenshots call its production picker directly.

## Overlaps
- #1738 changes `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs`, `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs`. I did not stack on #1738. It does not change the import functions. This PR changes other functions in those files. Whichever PR merges second refreshes.
- #2101 adds a field to `Graded` and changes the line that builds it. This PR does not build a `Graded`. It adds a separate match arm and module, so a merge is simple.
- #2122 adds dependency sections to `crates/app/Cargo.toml`. That is the same file, but a different section.
- #2091 changes `paint_hint` in `file_drop.rs`. This PR changes other functions in that file.

Effort: high (no escalation).

title: feat(boundaries)!: add "Do not touch" face/edge protection on 2D Offset and 3D Pocket
body:
Stacked on #2077 (merge #2077 first)

## What changed
- Added **Do not touch** protected faces, patches, and edge chains plus standoff **Clearance** (`>= 0.0` mm, default `0.0`) to `AreaControls` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs`, `area.rs`).
- Separated `has_boundary_edits()` from `is_default()` so empty protection preserves legacy toolpaths, boundary clipping, and generation stamps (`op_stamp` hashes `camcraft-do-not-touch-v1` only when protection is active).
- Added independent 3D full-tool keep-out generation and swept verification in `crates/sim/src/verify/` (`avoid.rs`, `avoid_poly.rs`, `avoid_links.rs`, `swept.rs`, `probe.rs`, `Warning::AvoidHit`), checking flutes, shank, and holder against `clearance + max(stock_to_leave, 0)` and elevating obstructed rapid traverses.
- Wired per-level keep-outs, `KeepDown` link chord checks (`prev_center` / `prev_state`), and impossible-room refusals into `2D Offset` (`machining2d::pocket_avoid`) and `3D Pocket` (`machining3d::pocket3d_avoid`, `shell.rs`, `ladder.rs`, `entry.rs`), plus upright `route_links` and upright/tilted `verify_avoid` in `generate.rs`.
- Added live post-gate checks (`live_avoid_problems` in `posting.rs`) so violated or stale/overlapping protected items block NC posting.
- Added undoable `SetOperationDoNotTouch`, overlap and vertex validation across `EditOperationParams`, `SetOperationGeometry`, `ChangeOperationKind`, and `EditOperationLinks`, MCP tools `get_operation_do_not_touch` / `set_operation_do_not_touch`, and refused non-default `"Do not touch"` on unsupported operation kinds by name.
- Rendered `"Do not touch"` UI controls, rows with `"×"` remove + viewport hover highlight, and persistent selection viewport overlays (`crates/ui/src/avoid_viz.rs`, `egui_app/boundary.rs`, `boundary_draft.rs`).
- Bumped `PROJECT_VERSION` `63 -> 64` (stacked on `#2077`) so pre-v64 readers refuse files carrying `"do_not_touch"` rather than ignoring protection.
- Updated `site/content/guide/` docs, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, and `docs/decisions/2055-do-not-touch.md`.

## UI review evidence (#2149)

Review-fix head: `928c878dbcdae917f1de9523213caeb1874b451d`. Merged `upstream/main` at `a49322b9c0c049bd0b3b2d1dea855de6087ac64b`; kept the cutting-data and Weldon holder descriptions. Both new commits carry `Fixes #2055`.

Validation of this head: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (53.0 min, 5 steps, 0 failed). Clippy on tools, sim, motion, app, and ui, all targets with `-D warnings`, passed.

The same 2200 × 1200 scene and camera are used in both captures. Before renders the pre-feature parent Boundary source (`dfbc9b18a^`) in the merged shell, with the protection overlay disabled. After renders the current PR UI. The after view shows the protected face and edge-chain rows, Clearance 1.25 mm, and viewport protection marks. These are GPU-rendered shell captures; no screenshot or capture harness is committed on this PR branch.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: parent Boundary UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/37652ad68277c01babd8fb2996b41ed38e4cc7bd/2149/before.png) | ![After: protected rows, clearance, and viewport marks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/37652ad68277c01babd8fb2996b41ed38e4cc7bd/2149/after.png) |

The structural pin `geometry_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_rows_and_viewport_marks` also checks that both protected-item descriptions appear below Clearance in selection order. Mutation: hide the row descriptions → RED; restore → GREEN.

## Cause
Users needed a way on the Geometry tab (`Boundary` -> `Boundaries`) to pick model faces or edge chains that no cut, plunge, ramp, helix, keep-down link, or rapid move could touch or approach within clearance across the full tool assembly (flutes, shank, holder). Previously, `AreaControls` only supported 2D XY machining/containment boundary regions without 3D Z-aware full-stack keep-outs, rapid elevation, or post-blocking `AvoidHit` checks.

## Tests
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: `wall 30.8 min, 5 step(s), 0 failed` (`tools 0s`, `sim 23s`, `motion 700s`, `app 1071s`, `ui 39s`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green (`0` warnings/errors).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test verify_avoid`: `2 passed; 0 failed` (`detects_axial_holder_and_edge_clearance_violations`, `detects_zero_clearance_graze_and_link_obstruction`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test avoid_pocket`: `3 passed; 0 failed` (`empty_avoid_matches_plain_paths_exactly`, `pocket_avoid_all_strategies_entries_holder_and_edge`, `pocket3d_avoid_shell_rest_and_adaptive_stay_clear`).

body:
Supersedes #2036

GitHub closed #2036 when its parent #2023 merged and its base branch was deleted. This PR has the same branch.

## Merge of main

- `git merge origin/main` was clean (no conflicts, no hand edits in the merge).
- The fix commit cfadf347b wrote `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` with CRLF line ends. The diff showed each line of that file as changed. Commit 6a800e5ce restores LF. The content does not change. The diff of `interact.rs` against main is now 14 lines added and 2 lines removed.

- The world gizmo draws only the axes that the machine has.

- Display only. The WCS, the toolpaths and the posted G-code do not read it.
- Decision: `docs/decisions/2019-lathe-gizmo.md` (mill-turn rule).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/cc3a8de149ae431f676678061599bc7885aff9e1/pr-2019/lathe-gizmo-before.png

title: fix(sim): resolve sub-pitch carried side-face and step contact
body:
## What changed

- Added continuous region classification (`carry_boundary.rs`, `carry_boundary_prune.rs`) and adaptive spatial boundary subdivision (`carried_boundary_scan.rs`) in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/`.
- Exported `boundary_box_penetration` and `boundary_mesh_penetration`, and wired them into `penetration` and `mesh_penetration` in `crates/app/src/fixture_carried.rs`.
- Preserved exact `x1, y1` block bounds in `Dexel::block`, cylinder bounds across `air_outside_circle` and `Dexel::translate_origin`, and closed `FixtureMesh` provenance in `Body::on_mesh`.
- Added generalized axis-aligned mesh queries (`BoxSteel`, `steel_on_axis_line`, `steel_on_line_local`, `collect_tris_in_xy`, `steel_in_axis_box`, `steel_in_axis_box_uv`) in `crates/sim/src/fixture_mesh/`.
- Added zero-allocation bounds fast paths in `Profile::floor` and routed `fixture_carried::material` through `Body::needs_continuous_column`.
- Added `crates/app/tests/carried_fixture_side_contact.rs`, `crates/sim/tests/carried_boundary.rs`, updated two unit-grid assertions in `carried_fixture_guards.rs`, and added `docs/decisions/1580-side-face-contact.md`.

## Cause

Carried-workholding checks relied on dexel column centres and `between_columns` intersection over four cell corners. `Dexel::block` rounded history bounds to `cell` multiples, `air_outside_circle` cleared `history`, `Body::on_mesh` dropped mesh provenance, and boundary cells sampled only four column centres. Steel extending up to one grid pitch past a side face or step missed column centres and passed.

## Tests

- Pins (`carried_fixture_side_contact`, 6 tests: `box_block_refuses_sub_pitch_side_face_overlap_at_four_grid_phases`, `cylinder_stock_refuses_sub_pitch_side_face_overlap_and_allows_tangent_contact`, `model_stock_refuses_sub_pitch_side_face_overlap_at_four_grid_phases`, `step_face_refuses_sub_pitch_overlap_and_clears_recessed_jaw`, `side_turned_machined_wall_refuses_sub_pitch_overlap_and_allows_contact`, `flipped_hat_refuses_sub_pitch_jaw_overlap_from_tenth_to_seven_tenths_pitch`): failed `0/6` on unchanged `upstream/main`; pass `6/6` after final edit.

- Mutation probes (run prior to the final `clipped_range` clippy parameter-grouping refactor, restored after each):
  - Reverted `fixture_carried.rs`: `carried_fixture_side_contact` failed `0/6`; passed `6/6` on restore.
  - Reverted `carry.rs`: `model_stock_refuses_sub_pitch_side_face_overlap_at_four_grid_phases` failed; passed on restore.
  - Dropped `h.cylinder` retention in `tiles.rs`: `cylinder_stock_refuses_sub_pitch_side_face_overlap_and_allows_tangent_contact` failed; passed on restore.
  - Reverted `dexel.rs`: `box_block_refuses_sub_pitch_side_face_overlap_at_four_grid_phases` failed; passed `6/6` on restore.
- Clippy (`cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`): passed with zero warnings after final edit.
- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): passed `3/3` steps (`sim` 307s, `motion` 10s, `app` 443s, 0 failed) after final Rust edit.

title: fix(motion): cut shallow 3D blind floors in one level
body:
Stacked on #2013 (merge #2013 first)

## What changed
- Add `machining3d::rest::rough_levels` with helpers `masked_target`, `sort_dedup_heights`, `flat_floor_heights_between`, and `vertex_heights_between` in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/rest.rs`.
- Switch `run_plain` and the coarse leg of `run_rest` in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs` from `cut_levels_under` to `rough_levels`.
- Remove the `#2004` `no_plane_in_hole` refusal bypass from `blind_floor::a_blind_pocket_never_enters_solid_under_any_ladder` in `crates/motion/tests/blind_floor.rs` so all 288 sweeps generate clean paths.
- Add pinning tests `a_blind_hole_shallower_than_one_stepdown_is_cut_at_its_floor`, `a_shallow_blind_hole_beside_a_deeper_cut_is_still_cut_at_its_floor`, and `shallow_blind_hole_edge_cases_hold` in `crates/motion/tests/blind_floor.rs`.
- Record the design decision in `docs/decisions/2088-pocket3d-shallow-blind-floor.md`.
- Keep `pocket3d_air_split` and the half-step rest pass on `cut_levels_under`.

## Cause
PR #2013 (#2004) started `cut_levels` at `top_z - stepdown` instead of `top_z`. A blind hole shallower than one stepdown has no ladder plane between `top_z` and its floor when `bottom_z` sits at or below that floor. Isolated shallow pockets refused with `"nothing to machine: nothing to cut: the model fills the pocket at every level"`. Shallow blind floors inside a footprint that also covered open stock or a deeper cut were skipped.

`rough_levels` inspects heights strictly between the first ladder plane and `p.top_z`. It adds up-facing horizontal floor heights whose tool-center region adds cut area not already covered below `first`. When `first` is empty and no flat floor fits, it selects the deepest cuttable triangle vertex height in that band. When a shallow flat floor is narrower than the tool, it keeps that plane so `ladder` reports `"too narrow"` by tool diameter.

## Tests
- **Before fix (on `base-2013` `a290caad`)**:
  - `blind_floor::a_blind_hole_shallower_than_one_stepdown_is_cut_at_its_floor` failed with `"nothing to machine: nothing to cut: the model fills the pocket at every level"`.
  - `blind_floor::a_shallow_blind_hole_beside_a_deeper_cut_is_still_cut_at_its_floor` failed with `"blind hole must be cut: []"`.
- **Mutation checks**:
  1. Reverted `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs` and `crates/motion/src/machining3d/rest.rs` to `base-2013`. Running `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test blind_floor` failed 4 of 5 tests (`a_blind_pocket_never_enters_solid_under_any_ladder`, `a_blind_hole_shallower_than_one_stepdown_is_cut_at_its_floor`, `a_shallow_blind_hole_beside_a_deeper_cut_is_still_cut_at_its_floor`, and `shallow_blind_hole_edge_cases_hold`). Restored the fix and all 5 tests passed in 3.91s.
  2. Forced an early return `if !empty_below { return Ok(zs); }` in `rough_levels`. Running `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test blind_floor` failed `a_shallow_blind_hole_beside_a_deeper_cut_is_still_cut_at_its_floor` (`"blind hole must be cut: []"`). Restored the fix and all 5 tests passed in 3.90s.
- **Quick gate vs stack base (`cargo xtask gate quick --base base-2013`)**: passed (2 steps, 0 failed, wall 5.0 min).
  - `[01] motion suites`: 6 suites, 411 passed, 0 failed, 9 ignored (`--lib`: 387 passed, 6 ignored; `blind_floor`: 5/5; `islands_model_fault`: 2/2; `posed_subtract`: 1/1; `rotary_adaptive`: 3 passed, 3 ignored; `top_z_level`: 13/13).
  - `[02] app suites` (`shared_face_bodies`): 5 passed, 0 failed.
- **Quick gate vs upstream (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`)**:
  - `[01] post suites`: 61 suites, 561 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
  - `[02] motion suites`: 57 suites, 834 passed, 0 failed, 50 ignored (`--lib`: 6, `adaptive_hsm`: 5, `finish3d`: 33, `lead_room`: 1, `offset_shells`: 1, `pocket3d_hsm`: 1, `rotary_adaptive`: 3).
  - `[03] motion rotary_offset (2 fn)`: 2 passed, 0 failed, 7 filtered out.
  - `[04] app suites`: 464 suites (3338 passed, 25 failed across 10 pre-existing or sandbox targets, 34 ignored). All 25 failures belong outside #2088:
    - `docs_troubleshooting` (1): stacked parent `base-2013` predates #2119.
    - `mcp_live` (6): standard sandbox denied loopback TCP `connect`; re-running `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live` outside the sandbox passed 10/10.
    - Remaining 18 failures across 8 suites (`operations` 3, `predrilled_entry` 2, `project_roundtrip` 1, `remachining` 2, `stitch_cross` 2, `turning_face_approach` 1, `turning_face_seed` 1, `wall_arc_entry` 6) all assert old Top Z levels or refusal text on draft parent #2013 (`base-2013`). All 3D Pocket, Rest, and Blind Floor `app` suites (`blind_floor` 8/8, `pocket3d_hsm` 1/1 + 1 ignored, `pocket3d_open_side` 7/7, `pocket3d_reach` 6/6, `pocket_overhead` 2/2, `pocket_recognition` 11/11, `rest_across_setups` 7/7, `shared_face_bodies` 5/5, `suppressed_rest` 2/2, `top_z_stock_over` 2/2, `whole_model_pocket` 5/5 + 1 ignored) passed.
- **Clippy**: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with 0 warnings.

## Goldens moved

Changes `run_plain`, `run_rest`, and `pocket3d_air_split` in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs`, plus `a_blind_pocket_never_enters_solid_under_any_ladder` in `crates/motion/tests/blind_floor.rs`. title: fix(edm): add wire tool kind and gate EDM tool UI visibility
body:
## What changed
- Added `ToolKind::Wire` (`"wire"` / `"EDM wire"`), non-spinning (`rpm == 0`, `corner_r == 0`, diameter in `[0.02, 1.0]` mm, no cutting-data rows), `tool-wire.svg`/`tool-wire.png`, and catalog entry `"EDM-W025"` (`0.25` mm brass wire).
- Changed `OpType::WireContour` (`tool_law::WIRE`) to mount a `ToolKind::Wire` library tool (`mounts_tool() == true`).
- Changed `wire_op::condition_of` and `wire_op::one_condition` to read `wire_diameter` from the mounted `ToolKind::Wire` tool, require `ConditionField::Gap`, enforce agreement against `edm.wire_diameters` and any condition-stated `wire_diameter` within `WIRE_MATCH_MM`, and refuse `gap >= wire_diameter * 0.5`.
- Updated `collect_job`, `current_stamp`, `stale_reason`, operation commands (`create`, `paste`, `edit`, `retype`, `retarget`), `setup_sheet`, `cutting`, `posting`, `stock_sim`, `project::validate`, and UI quick-add / tool settings to mount and validate `ToolKind::Wire`.
- Added `machine_modes::tool_kind_offered` and filtered Tool Library catalog, Tool type filter, and New Tool dropdown so a tool kind appears only when at least one `KindInfo` entry accepts it and admits a selectable `MACHINE_MODES` entry or mounted machine.
- Recorded architectural rationale in `docs/decisions/2011-edm-wire-tool.md`.

## Cause
`OpType::WireContour` previously used `tk::NO_TOOL`, leaving Wire EDM users with no selectable wire tool in the catalog or operation Tool row while storing wire diameter only inside machine `.mch` condition rows. Meanwhile, the Tool Library and New Tool dropdown listed every `ToolKind` unconditionally, exposing `Sinker electrode` / `"EDM-E10X6"` even while `Kind::SinkerEdm` is absent from `MACHINE_MODES`.

## Tests
- **Pins (red before fix, green after)**:
  - `camcraft-app --test wire_tool`: `wire_contour_mounts_a_wire_tool_and_catalog_lists_one` failed on `upstream/main` (`af83da0`); now all 5 tests in `wire_tool` pass (refusals on bad rpm/diameter/corner/cutting rows, kerf & NC path shifting on wire tool edit with stamp staleness, machine/condition/skim/tab-cutoff/spark-gap mismatch checks).
  - `camcraft-ui --lib edm_tool_visibility`: `sinker_electrode_is_hidden_when_sinker_edm_is_not_selectable_and_wire_is_offered` failed on `upstream/main` (`EDM-E10X6` visible without `SinkerEdm`); now both tests pass (`EDM-E10X6` and `Sinker electrode` stay hidden without `SinkerEdm`, reveal together when a custom `sinker_edm` `.mch` mounts, and `EDM-W025` / `"EDM wire"` work end-to-end).
- **Mutation checks (red when mutated, green when restored)**:
  - Reverted `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library.rs` to `upstream/main`: `edm_tool_visibility` failed (`EDM-E10X6` exposed); restored passes.
  - Bypassed `TOOL_KINDS` filter in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs`: `edm_tool_visibility` failed (`Sinker electrode` offered); restored passes.
  - Bypassed `crates/tools/src/wire.rs::refusal`: `wire_tool` failed (`BadRpm` accepted); restored passes.
  - Bypassed each guard in `crates/app/src/operation/wire_op.rs` (`edm.wire_diameters` check, `c.wire_diameter` match check, and `gap >= wire_diameter * 0.5` check): `wire_tool` failed on each guard independently; restored passes.
- **Gate & Lint**:
  - `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed. Including `camcraft-ui` is blocked by the upstream `short_caption` match missing `Waterjet` (E0004).
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED on the upstream UI `Waterjet` compile error. Tools passed (6s), all 281 app binaries passed (992s), UI compilation failed (74s); no UI gate tests ran.
  - `cargo test -p xtask icons`: passed (7 passed, 0 failed).

## Goldens moved
None (`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty).
(`wire_stamp::ONE_PROFILE_STAMP` moved to digest the mounted `EDM-W025` tool alongside `stamp_condition`.)

## Not exercised
- `cargo xtask gate release` pixel-snapshot suites.
- Physical Wire EDM or Sinker EDM machine cutting tests.

## Overlaps
No open PR modifies the same functions or lines. These open PRs touch some of the same files in different functions or lines (whichever merges second refreshes):
- #2077 (`file.rs`, `edit.rs`, `state.rs`)
- #2092 (`file.rs`, `tool_settings.rs`)
- #2126 (`file.rs`, `kinds.rs`)
- #2125 (`machine_wire_edm.rs`)
- #2110 (`catalog_asset.rs`)
- #2090 (`tool_icons.rs`)
- #2048, #1821 (`create.rs`, `edit.rs`)
- #1817, #2093, #2037 (`edit.rs`, `gates.rs`, `kinds.rs`)
- #1921 (`wire_verify.rs`)
- #1713 (`kinds.rs`)
- #1798 (`icons.rs`, `state.rs`)
- #1738 (`state.rs`)
- #1330 (`state.rs`, held)
- #1753 (adds `SinkerEdm` to `MACHINE_MODES`, no shared lines — unblocks `Sinker electrode` visibility once merged)

## Latest review fixes

Head: `4a9c638436bbd3e6f4a86907f4c3a4a8e7a27c4c`. Merged upstream main `57f2ffbbf` cleanly before applying the fixture fix.

- Legacy Wire Contours with empty tool references now open in a recovery state. Their saved machine condition and wire diameter remain unchanged. Cached paths and generation stamps are cleared, and a load note requests a wire tool. Generation and posting refuse until a valid tool is explicitly assigned. Pinned by `wire_tool::legacy_wire_project_opens_without_a_tool_and_requires_recovery_before_posting`, including successful posting after explicit recovery.
- `wire_verify_tol` mounts `EDM-W025` and retains its tolerance, posting, and project assertions. Both tests pass.
- Reverting validation, removing recovery, retaining the stamp, retaining the cache, and restoring the empty-tool fixture each made its pin RED; each restoration was GREEN.
- The existing `edm_tool_visibility` tests pass. Bypassing catalog filtering and New Tool filtering independently made them RED, and restoring each filter returned GREEN. Before/after screenshots are linked below.

## UI before and after

These are actual 1600 × 1200 egui shell renders. Before uses the pre-change parent `af83da0f4`; after uses reviewed head `b20b3d30b`. A temporary test harness opened the same Tool library and New Tool views. No source workaround was needed. The captures live only on the fork’s images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

Before has no wire tool, so its controls show the default End mill. After shows the EDM wire controls with 0.25 mm wire diameter and no spindle RPM or corner radius. The catalog and type menus show EDM wire becoming available and Sinker electrode being hidden when its machine kind is unavailable.

| View | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| EDM catalog entries | ![Before EDM catalog entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-before.png) | ![After EDM catalog entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-after.png) |
| Catalog type choices | ![Before Catalog type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-types-before.png) | ![After Catalog type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-types-after.png) |
| New Tool type choices | ![Before New Tool type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-types-before.png) | ![After New Tool type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-types-after.png) |
| Tool controls | ![Before Tool controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-controls-before.png) | ![After Tool controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-controls-after.png) |

Fixes #2011

title: fix(sim): judge rapids at the clearance plane against the stock
body:
## What changed

The mill column law (d) stood down for every lateral rapid at or above the clearance plane. A clearance plane set inside the stock sent the traverse through uncut stock and the program posted with no warning (#2121).

**Layer 1 - the law (`crates/sim/src/verify`)**

- `rapids.rs`: the clearance gate is gone. Every lateral rapid under the stock top is marched against the column, whatever plane it rides.
- Two re-reads for the convictions this adds (a lateral rapid at or above the plane). Each only removes a conviction; neither touches a rapid under the plane, so every pre-#2121 conviction keeps its own rules.
  - `traverse_solids.rs`, `acquit_traverses_by_solids`: the whole tool stack against the stock and part solids under the strip the rapid sweeps. Each facet is clipped to that strip, so a slope is read where the tool is, not at its far vertex. Closed shells only; fails closed.
  - `prior_traverse.rs`, `acquit_traverses_by_prior`: the stock grid the program ahead left, under the swept capsule, plus the part's own facets (a part reaching out of its stock is never air because the grid is silent about it).
- `types.rs`: the sentence is now `rapid move N travels through stock (below the clearance plane, or at it below the stock top)`. The variant `RapidInStock` and its file-format name are unchanged.

**Layer 2 - the operation layer (`crates/app`)**

- `operation/clearance_stock.rs` (new): generate's wiring of both re-reads (unposed and 3+2 branches), the path note `Clearance in stock: rapid move N travels through stock at Z ... - the clearance plane Z ... is inside the stock (top Z ...)`, and `operation::clearance_in_stock_advice`.
- `mcp/edit.rs`: `add_operation` and `edit_operation` answer with that advice as `warning`.
- Troubleshooting page and the UI fold's test literal follow the new sentence.

## Validate early: a word, not a refusal

I built the creation-time refusal first and dropped it. The door cannot see where the rapids will run (a profile beside the block never crosses it), so it would refuse legal programs, and it refused four standing fixtures at creation (`operations.rs`, `opframe_picks.rs`, `posted_gates`, `turning.rs`). The plane is named at creation instead (upright mill or vertical hole kind, flat-topped stock, nothing ahead in the program), and the law holds the post. Record: `docs/decisions/2121-rapid-at-clearance-in-stock.md`. The app does not show the word yet: #2131.

## Operation families

| Family | Rapid law | Had the gate? | Now |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2D mill (Face, Contour, Pocket, Adaptive2D, Offset2D, Slot, Trochoidal Slot, Trace, Engrave, Chamfer2D, Circular) | column law (d) | yes | fixed |
| 3D mill (Pocket3D, Finish3D, Deburr) | column law (d) | yes | fixed |
| Drilling (Drill, Bore, Thread; vertical) | column law (d) | yes, for links | fixed |
| Multi-axis upright rapids (Contour5D, Parallel5D, Swarf, Flow5D, MultiAxisRough, MultiAxisContour) | column law (d), posed re-read for leaning rapids | yes | fixed |
| 3+2 tilted planes of the kinds above | column law (d) in the plane's frame | yes | fixed, with the solids re-read |
| Turning | meridian law (`turning_rapids.rs`) | no | unchanged |
| Rotary (RotaryContour, RotaryParallel, RotaryOffset) | `rotary_hits` | no | unchanged |
| Cross drilling | `rapids_radial.rs` | no | unchanged |

## How tested

New pins:

- `crates/app/tests/clearance_in_stock.rs` (8): the issue's Contour repro and a Slot are convicted on the traverse at the plane, carry the note, and `post_setup_unwritten` / `post_setup` refuse and write nothing; the same plane after a Face to Z 5 is clean and posts; a Face to Z 9 does not excuse it; a plane at the stock top is clean; the advice speaks on raw flat stock and stands down behind an earlier op, on a tilted plane and on a stepped stock (where the law still convicts); the MCP tools answer with `warning`.
- `sim` unit tests: `verify::prior_traverse` (7), `verify::traverse_solids` (6). `app` unit tests: `operation::clearance_stock` (3).

Red before: with the gate restored (mutation M1) the Contour, Slot, shallow-Face, stepped-stock and first-op pins fail.

Mutation checks, each killed by at least one pin: gate restored; prior always clears; prior re-read off; part guard off; advice off; advice ignores the program ahead; prior re-read also under the plane; advice treats every stock as flat; solids re-read off (kills `stock_source_holes::framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number`); solids re-read never convicts; solids re-read also under the plane; one clip side skipped; MCP warning off; advice on a tilted plane.

Runs on the final head:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-fail-fast`: 635 test binaries, all pass (debug, default lanes).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, 4 steps, 0 failed, 11.1 min (sim 38 s, motion 4 s, app 551 s, ui 72 s).

## Goldens and existing tests

No golden file changed. One existing test changed: `operations.rs::an_entry_edit_marks_the_slot_stale_and_the_orbit_proves_itself` asserted exactly one path note. Its fixture is itself unsafe (Slot top Z 0, clearance Z 5 inside a 0..20 block), so it now carries the new `Clearance in stock:` note beside #104's; the two assertions read "exactly these two height notes". The #96/#1066/#1091/#1095 pins are unchanged and pass.

## Not exercised

- The `--ignored` release heavy lanes and the pixel snapshots.
- No cut on a machine; no hand-test in the app.
- Windows and Linux (run on macOS only).
- A path cached before this fix keeps its cached warnings until it is regenerated (the op stamp salt was not bumped).
- A part or stock mesh that is not one closed shell gets no solids re-read: its traverse convictions stand (fail closed), which can refuse a legal low-clearance program on such a mesh.

## Overlap

The #1559 worker's branch (`issue/1559-2d-entry-below-stock`, no PR yet) edits `generate.rs` beside the `top_stock::note` call and `operation/mod.rs` beside its export; this PR adds one line at each place. Not stacked: based on `upstream/main` (98f093fba). Whichever merges second takes a small merge of main.

Changelog: A rapid at the clearance plane is now judged against the stock: a clearance height set inside the stock is convicted by name and holds the post; MCP add/edit answer with a warning.
Effort: max (issue labelled effort:high; not escalated)

Fixes #2121

title: fix(wcs): carry Z-rotated work offset through generation and post
body:
## What changed
- Split work-offset frame classification (`OffsetFrame::Yaw` vs tilted `OffsetFrame::Rotated`) in `crates/app/src/posting_wcs_rotation.rs`.
- Carry pure Z-axis WCS rotation into milling toolpath generation via `WcsYaw` (`crates/app/src/operation/wcs_yaw.rs`, `generate.rs`, `job.rs`, `stamp.rs`, `drill_prior.rs`), `SlotBound::rotated_xy` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room.rs`), and `Dexel::rotated_z_conservative` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/dexel.rs`).
- Rotate generated `Toolpath`, `Region`, and located errors back to Setup table frame `S` before simulation, verification, workholding checks, fixture linking, and machine travel limit checks.
- Add `WcsRotationOutput` (`Bake` default, `Control` opt-in) across schema, project DTOs, posting, MCP `set_post_options`, setup sheet, and the Post Options UI (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`, `posting.rs`, `project/*`, `mcp/post_options_tools.rs`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_options.rs`).
- Add `crates/post/src/post/wcs_rotate.rs` and `controller.coordinate_rotation` / `wcsRotation` capability checks across `.mch` and five `.cps` posts (`fanuc`, `haas`, `mazak`, `doosan-dnm` emit `G68`/`G69`; `sinumerik` emits `ROT RPL=`/`ROT`).
- Refuse probing, turning, EDM, 5-axis/3+2 moves, and XZ/YZ arcs under a Z-rotated WCS, and guard `Align WCS (3-2-1)` against tilted faces on `Kind::Mill` (`crates/app/src/setup_wcs_tilt.rs`, `crates/ui/src/vertex_pick.rs`, `geo_page.rs`).

## Cause
Milling strategy generators and rest-prior grids ran directly in setup table coordinates `S`, ignoring any Z rotation on the setup WCS. Posting also rejected every rotated offset unconditionally regardless of whether only Z yaw was present.

## Tests
- Pins (`crates/post/tests/wcs_rotate.rs`): `bake_keeps_setup_table_coordinates_without_g68`, `control_mode_emits_g68_or_rot_only_when_machine_and_post_declare_it`, `mch_parser_reads_optional_controller_coordinate_rotation`, `probing_or_non_xy_arc_under_rotated_wcs_refuses_by_name`, `five_axis_abc_move_in_rotated_wcs_refuses_by_name`.
- Pins (`crates/app/tests/wcs_rotation_carry.rs`): `face_passes_and_bake_post_follow_90_deg_z_rotated_wcs`, `face_passes_and_bake_post_align_to_30_deg_yaw`, `changing_wcs_yaw_marks_generated_op_stale`, `machine_travel_limits_check_physical_table_coordinates_under_rotated_wcs`, `setup_sheet_states_z_rotation_without_refusing_while_tilt_still_refuses`.
- Pins (`crates/app/tests/wcs_rotation_control.rs`): `control_rotation_fanuc_emits_g68_g69_and_preserves_viewer_map`, `control_rotation_sinumerik_and_capability_refusals`, `rotated_wcs_carries_pocket_slot_circular_and_drill_ops`, `rotated_wcs_carries_pocket3d_rest_prior_grid`.
- Pins (`crates/app/tests/rotated_wcs.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_align_guard_tests.rs`, plus `mcp_post_options.rs` and `setup_post_options.rs`): `the_post_stream_carries_z_offset_rotation`, `a_tilted_work_offset_is_refused_by_name`, `the_setup_sheet_states_the_offset_rotation`, `align_wcs_321_refuses_tilted_side_face_on_mill_and_names_part_alignment`, `align_wcs_321_allows_top_face_with_z_yaw_on_mill`.
- Mutation 1: reverted `operation/{job.rs, generate.rs}` -> `face_passes_and_bake_post_follow_90_deg_z_rotated_wcs` failed -> restored, passed.
- Mutation 2: reverted `operation/stamp.rs` -> `changing_wcs_yaw_marks_generated_op_stale` failed -> restored, passed.
- Mutation 3: reverted `post/engine.rs` -> 4/5 tests in `crates/post/tests/wcs_rotate.rs` failed -> restored, passed.
- Mutation 4: mutated `OffsetFrame::Yaw` in `posting_wcs_rotation.rs` to refuse -> `face_passes_and_bake_post_follow_90_deg_z_rotated_wcs` failed -> restored, passed.
- Mutation 5: reverted `ui/{vertex_pick.rs, egui_app/geo_page.rs}` -> `align_wcs_321_refuses_tilted_side_face_on_mill_and_names_part_alignment` failed -> restored, passed.
- Gate & clippy: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (`post`, `sim`, `motion`, `app`, `ui`; 0 failed); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

## UI review evidence (#2136)

These are 1600 × 1000 GPU-rendered egui shell captures from the same `ShellUi::seeded()` document and camera (`Block` 60 × 60 × 30 mm, `Contour1`). Images live only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch (`78e0bb35eb710981386ef24748b635bbc9d32f5d`).

| View | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Post Options (`WCS rotation`) | ![Before: Post Options without WCS rotation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/78e0bb35eb710981386ef24748b635bbc9d32f5d/2136/post-options-before.png) | ![After: Post Options with WCS rotation picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/78e0bb35eb710981386ef24748b635bbc9d32f5d/2136/post-options-after.png) |
| Operation Geometry (`Align WCS (3-2-1)`) | ![Before: Align WCS enabled for tilted side face](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/78e0bb35eb710981386ef24748b635bbc9d32f5d/2136/align-321-before.png) | ![After: Align WCS disabled with Part alignment refusal tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/78e0bb35eb710981386ef24748b635bbc9d32f5d/2136/align-321-after.png) |

## Goldens moved
None (`git diff --stat -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty).

## Not exercised
- Full non-quick `cargo xtask gate` outside `gate quick --base upstream/main`.
- Execution of posted `G68` / `ROT RPL=` code on physical CNC controls.
- Other `.cps` scripts beyond `fanuc`, `haas`, `mazak`, `doosan-dnm`, and `sinumerik` in `Control` mode (they remain allowed in `Bake` and refused in `Control`).

## Overlaps
Touches the same files (different functions/arms; whichever merges second refreshes) with open PRs `#2134`, `#2129`, `#2126`, `#2123`, `#2115`, `#2101`, `#2093`, `#2092`, `#2089`, `#2083`, `#2077`, `#2048`, `#2037`, `#2035`, `#2013`, `#1821`, `#1817`, `#1753`, `#1738`, `#1713`, `#1701`, `#1681`, `#1330`, `#1209`, and `#468`.

Changelog: Carry pure Z-axis WCS rotation through milling toolpath generation and Bake or Control (G68/ROT) posting, and guard 3-2-1 mill face alignment against tilted faces.

Process change: yes

Fixes #760

title: docs(guide): add "Your first 4-axis part" (3+1 indexed, 770MX + microARC 4)
body:
## What changed

This PR adds the guide page "Your first 4-axis part". It is the 3+1 indexed part of #1904. The maintainer's scope note of 2026-11-15 gives the title and the place.

- **The page:** `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-4axis-part.md`. It makes one part from start to finish on the Tormach 770MX with the microARC 4 (`tormach-770mx-microarc4.mch`, `tormach.cps`).
  - The part is a 3/4 in round bar with a flat on each of four faces (A-90, A0, A90, A180) and a cross slot on the A0 face.
  - The page gives the machine, post and unit, the model, stock and work offset on the A centreline, the two tools, the five operations, the checks, the posted program, the PathPilot simulator check, and the steps on the machine.
  - Each operation is a typed Slot with its own **Tilted plane (3+2)**. One setup holds all five operations.
- **Links:** the Getting started index, `first-run.md` (next to the router first part) and the Multi-axis index link the page. The plasma first part (#1905) is not on `main`, thus the link is next to the router part.
- **Companion files:** `examples/first-4axis-part.camproj`, `examples/first-4axis-part.nc`, `examples/models/first-4axis-part.obj` and its generator `gen_first_4axis_part_obj.py`.
- `.gitattributes` holds the example program to LF, because a test compares it byte for byte.
- `docs/decisions/1904-first-4axis-part.md` records the decisions.

## Not in this PR: the continuous 4-axis walkthrough

The continuous part of #1904 is not written. `assets/posts/tormach.cps` refuses an A that changes inside an operation ("simultaneous 4-axis motion ... not confirmed on PathPilot"). #796 must give the PathPilot Hub results first. The page says this and lists the refusals. Thus this PR uses `Refs`, and #1904 stays open.

## How the project and the program were made

- `crates/app/tests/first_4axis_part.rs` builds the project through the app's commands and writes the three example files (`WRITE_GOLDEN=1`).
- `camcraft-cli process examples/first-4axis-part.camproj -o out.nc` on `upstream/main` `af83da0f4` writes a program that is the same as `examples/first-4axis-part.nc`, byte for byte (5 operations, 140 lines).
- A second build through `camcraft-cli mcp` gave the same program, byte for byte. Its steps were: `load_machine`, `set_units`, `import_model`, `fit_stock` with margin 0, `add_tool`, `edit_tool`, `add_operation`, `generate`, `post`.
